source.bindingRule: At publication, bind the exact product commit and rebuilt WASM/manifest identities to this frozen C source and patch. A different C source is not qualified by this registration.

criterionSource: Root explicit prospective instruction before any prefix-selector component timing; independently reviewed by benchmark_setup.
rationale: JMdict priority motivates a candidate-specific 1% review threshold. This was chosen before runtime observations; untimed opportunity counts are not a prediction of elapsed-time benefit.

protocol.orderWithinHost: Alternating paired order under unchanged observer
protocol.timingBoundary: Page file-input change event to post-UI import-complete event; raw browser monotonic clock
protocol.pairChangeDefinition: 100 * (candidate elapsed / baseline elapsed - 1), summarized by median within each host

promotionReview.descriptivePaired95Interval: Both endpoints strictly below zero on each independent target host
promotionReview.identicalCodeControls: Variation materially smaller than candidate effect, explicitly assessed per host; no subtraction

nonTargetRejection.descriptivePaired95Interval: Both endpoints strictly above zero on each independent host
nonTargetRejection.identicalCodeControls: Variation smaller than the regression effect
nonTargetRejection.consequence: A qualifying replicated slowdown on either non-target corpus rejects or holds this exact candidate
nonTargetRejection.inconclusivePolicy: Report uncertainty explicitly; an inconclusive non-target cohort does not prove nonregression

inferenceLimits: No timing-directed removal, replacement, or retries
No substitution of profiled/component results for complete-import evidence
Descriptive intervals are not a universal-speedup guarantee
earlierRegistrations: Receipt and numeric-suffix criteria remain unchanged.
publicationStatus: Review registration only; no workflow or product publication by this reviewer.
